authority.proof_rule: A correlated chord endpoint is not an independently represented point. Recompute contacts on the original selected-circle carrier and accept only those for which the original exact cardinal-chord branch predicate is zero. When independently constructed pair maps encode the same contact, replay that predicate before trying to separate their equal root intervals.
authority.persistent_state_added: one feature-gated Arc word per pair-shared rational parameter map; no state is duplicated per contact or retained endpoint

policy_evidence.strict: The direct overlap/touch matrix and public later Boolean complete from exact carrier identity, exact rational point reconstruction, and the existing exact branch-sign authority. No interval terminal is needed.
policy_evidence.approximate_512: The same proof graph completes as Certified for the supported fixtures. APPROXIMATE_512 remains observable only at the shared 512-bit terminal for otherwise unresolved equality; no approximate coordinate, parameter, support, or topology is retained.
policy_evidence.construction_policy: Every retained circle, chord, map, and endpoint is replayed only under its construction policy. The public fixture is rebuilt independently under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512.
policy_evidence.uncertainty_rule: An uncertain point reconstruction or branch sign remains uncertain. The fast path returns equality only for an exact zero sign and cannot turn terminal approximation into reusable evidence.

fixture.wide_cutter: Transform the source by x' = 4x + 1/10 and y' = 7y/10 + 3/10, then offset outward by exactly 1/40 with an exact miter.

fixture.superseded_fixture_note: Benchmark 829d692 used a clip whose historical path already completed, so it was not a valid capability denominator. Benchmark 4e40099 replaces it with the public wide-cutter fixture and is the authoritative lane.

benchmark_method.timing_scope: Source construction, offsets, first-stage Boolean, replay clip construction, and semantic preflights are outside each timed loop. Timed operations rebuild either later exact intersection evidence or one later all-four Boolean batch.
benchmark_method.perf_command: taskset -c 11 perf stat -x, -e cycles,instructions -- env HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_GROUP=algebraic_round_boolean/shared_chord_collinear_reentry HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_SAMPLES=1 HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_ITERS=<256-current-or-1-historical> HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_IMPL=<implementation> <comparative-executable>
benchmark_method.perf_normalization: Subtract the matched disabled process. Divide current by 257 and historical by 2 because Runner performs one warm-up operation before its fixed timed iterations.
benchmark_method.heap_method: Heaptrack --record-only captures 16 current fixed timed iterations. Subtract the matched disabled process and divide by 17 for the one-operation warm-up. heaptrack_print summaries are authoritative.
benchmark_method.historical_control: Revision 568796e with only the corrected benchmark revision 4e40099 cherry-picked as detached revision c39a010.
benchmark_method.competitive_control: Cavalier Contours uses binary64 polylines, floating round/miter offsets, a floating first-stage intersection, and four separate Boolean calls; it is not exactness- or topology-equivalent.

historical_568796e.rejection: Both lanes return no usable result after exhausting the old equal-root refinement path.

matched_wall_performance.interpretation: Current is both complete and thousands of times faster because exact correlated equality bypasses futile root-interval separation. Cavalier remains only a floating throughput sentinel.

deterministic_perf.interpretation: The old path spends hundreds of billions of instructions refining two exact aliases and still rejects. The new branch predicate both proves equality and allows the existing Boolean engine to finish four regions.

allocation_evidence.historical_trace: Not collected: a single historical rejection retires about 319.6 billion fixture-subtracted instructions, and tracing that failed path would create disproportionate time and trace-volume cost without a correctness-equivalent allocation comparison.

allocation_evidence.interpretation: The completed public all-four batch keeps peak incremental heap below 8 KiB. Allocation churn remains an optimization target after adjacent correctness boundaries are closed.
